LanguageData.ARIO_LM_RemoteEstate: This is a remote managed estate, not an additional colony. Its available levies can be committed to landmark expeditions; ordinary holding muster and issued equipment remain separate.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_UpgradeDetails_0: Barracks increase garrison capacity by 8 and improve defensive readiness at each level.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_UpgradeDetails_1: Farms increase food tax and local off-map garrison provisions.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_UpgradeDetails_2: Coin mints increase silver tax by 25% per level.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_UpgradeConfirm: Improve {0} for {1} silver, {2} wood and {3} granite blocks from the chosen home base? Construction takes time and can be interrupted by capture.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_LevyTip: Local levy reserves are a finite pool. Commit up to eight at a time to reinforce this estate's garrison. Recruiting costs retained estate income and supplies. Realm expeditions use the existing paid holding muster, with its research, equipment and wages unchanged.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_CommitReserve: Assign local reserves to the garrison
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_AttackTip: Bring a real caravan to this location to claim or attack it personally, or dispatch available realm forces. Ownership changes only after victory. Friendly allies cannot be attacked without first ending their political connection.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_DispatchConfirm: Send {0} available troops to contest {1}, paying {2} silver from the selected home base? They will be unavailable while travelling, fighting and returning. Casualties and occupation detachments do not return to their source holdings.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_IntegrationReady: adapter available; live compatibility still requires testing
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_OpenDesc: Open this landmark's management in the Realm window.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_RestDesc: Rest here for six hours. Hospitality draws finite local provisions into the caravan's inventory; native food consumption handles meals. Rest, comfort and recreation recover gradually. Injuries are not instantly healed. Travel or a siege ends the visit.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_CollectDesc: Take this estate's uncollected silver and food tax into this caravan's real inventory. The stock is removed once. Automatic tax couriers retain up to 1,000 silver locally for recruitment; manual collection can withdraw that fund too.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_JoinDesc: Enter the landmark with this caravan and fight the approaching army manually.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_WarAidBody: {1} has declared war on {2} for control of {0}. An army is approaching. The defending House calls for assistance. You may travel with your caravan, dispatch selected available fighters, refuse, or leave the garrison to face the attack.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_MarchBody: Your army is marching to {0} to contest its garrison. The troops and their paid expedition cannot be used elsewhere while away.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_CapturedBody: {1} has defeated the defenders and taken control of {0} from {2}. Surviving improvements remain, but occupation, damage and losses will reduce the estate's benefits while it recovers. See the landmark's history for casualties.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_HeldBody: {2} has held {0} against {1}. The owner retains control. Losses, supplies spent and damage persist; surviving expedition forces must return before they are available again.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_AidTerms: Approaching force: {0} troops. Answer within {1}. Accepting a journey does not teleport your people; they must travel to the landmark. Dispatching selected fighters consumes travel provisions.
LanguageData.ARIO_LM_HelperSelection: Select equipped adult fighters from the current home map to dispatch. The journey requires pemmican provisions; insufficient provisions leave this offer unanswered.
